decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT SHADOW-COLUMN READ (owner decision 185; design section 4 with the section 8 rulings; claim ceiling 'nominated'). The DELIVERED column is the flight's own sealed answer, scored once by the flight with slurp-slu-official-train. Each shadow column -- relisten-replace-only (a: the section 1 acceptance rule) and relisten-replace-drop-unheard (b: a, plus dropping an entity when both contacts vote unheard) -- is rendered by the pure bind() from the same flight's sealed saea-relisten-v1 receipts and trace (AT1: a row with no accepted replacement and no drop renders byte-identical to the delivered text) and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch.score_complete_derived_copy; each contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915). PRIMARY: official pooled SLU-F1 (micro), shadow column minus delivered column. GUARD: intent is identical between each shadow column and the delivered column BY CONSTRUCTION (bind() never re-opens the decided intent); it is tested per row and the read REFUSES on any difference. THE BAR: the design's own null (ruling 7: 'the bar is the twin/shadow null'), provisional until this cell measures it: scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py design same-flight-shadow-relisten, 0.735 x sqrt(200 / n) = 0.3163 pp SLU-F1 at n = 1080. Per column: NOMINATED iff the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds 0.3163 pp AND the intent guard holds; SHADOW HARM iff the SLU-F1 CI95 upper bound is below zero AND the point delta's magnitude exceeds 0.3163 pp; otherwise NOT NOMINATED (within the null). The two columns are two pre-declared rules read from one contact stream; no rule search (decision 179). A nomination claims nothing at system level: promotion means binding in delivery and a full-system read against an in-chain A/A (design section 4). Descriptive, never gating: saves and harms by error kind (gold read on the scoring side only), the per-type table, the blind-disposition and confirm-vote tallies, and equal-scenario weighting; every verdict carries the per-scenario table.
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold A development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: the post-accept native_episode.relisten stage {"blind_template_id": "slurp_relisten_blind_v1", "confirm_template_id": "slurp_relisten_confirm_v1", "delivery": "shadow", "max_slots_per_row": 3, "policy": "saea-obs-targeted-relisten-v1", "value_max_words": 8}; the program switch to phase-native-candidates-review-revise-relisten-v1 is its carrier (ceiling +6), not a factor; the delivered path is the AGREE arm's modulo the program id in quoted contact ids and remaining_model_contacts (shadow_proof)
prohibitions: No test-split, Fold B or DEV contact or read.
No re-flying of the sealed AGREE arm.
No second factor: no other template, knob, store, roster, geometry or session change.
No live delivery of a relisten value: shadow only (ruling 5).
No transcript state: the relisten value never enters any role's context; only hashes are sealed in the receipt.
No Whisper or ASR tool contact (owner decision 180).
No flight before root mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No column score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a shadow-column effect may only nominate (ruling 7).
the_question: On TRAIN Fold A, with the AGREE form delivering its own answer, does a core-native targeted re-listen of up to three delivered entities per row (blind value, then a forced choice), bound offline into shadow column (a) replace-only or (b) replace-plus-drop-when-both-unheard, move official pooled SLU-F1 beyond the design's own null against the same flight's delivered column?
